sibal.label: SIBAL cotton/fiberglass fabric
sibal.note: Not the same as plain cotton: fiberglass changes behavior

cotton_jersey.label: Cotton jersey / interlock
cotton_jersey.note: Only cotton burned at reduced pressure / elevated O2 in our data

pmma.label: PMMA flat (acrylic)
pmma.investigations: BASS; BASS-II; Saffire II, IV, V
pmma.evidence_measured: spread vs thickness, O2, flow (BASS-II); sustained flaming without appreciable spread up to 25.4% O2 (Saffire V-3, concurrent, 71.3 kPa)
pmma.note: Richest dataset: 20 BASS-II slab tests + films

pmma_structured.label: PMMA structured surface
pmma_structured.note: Do NOT merge with flat PMMA

nomex.label: Nomex (meta-aramid) fabric
nomex.evidence_measured: no sustained flame in BASS-II F1-F3
nomex.note: Nomex III (BASS-II F1-F3). Keep separate from Nomex HT90-40 (TM-2008-215260) and from the PMMA-to-Nomex composite sample

nomex_ht90_40.label: Nomex HT90-40 fabric
nomex_ht90_40.investigations: Microgravity Flame Spread in Exploration Atmospheres (NASA/TM-2008-215260)
nomex_ht90_40.evidence_measured: 0g flammability limits (5 s drop tower): burns 23% / extinguishes 22% O2 at 14.7 psia, 30 cm/s concurrent
nomex_ht90_40.note: Different grade from BASS-II Nomex III; 1g ULOI 25.4% +/-0.6 (WSTF)

silicone.label: Silicone rubber sheet
silicone.evidence_measured: no sustained flame in microgravity despite 1g burning
silicone.note: Also has smoke evidence (SAME): keep as separate records

ultem_1000.label: Ultem 1000 film
ultem_1000.investigations: Microgravity Flame Spread in Exploration Atmospheres
ultem_1000.evidence_measured: 0g flammability limits (5 s drop tower): burns 24% / extinguishes 23% O2 at 10.2 psia, 30 cm/s concurrent
ultem_1000.note: 1g limits 2.5 points higher than 0g (26.5% ULOI WSTF); text 0g mean 22.5% conflicts with Table 1

mylar_g.label: Mylar G film
mylar_g.investigations: Microgravity Flame Spread in Exploration Atmospheres
mylar_g.evidence_measured: 0g flammability limits (5 s drop tower): burns 17% / extinguishes 16% O2 at 10.2 psia, 30 cm/s concurrent
mylar_g.note: 1g ULOI 20.8% (WSTF): 3.8 points above 0g; not transferable to every PET grade

kimwipes.label: Kimwipes tissue
kimwipes.investigations: Microgravity Flame Spread in Exploration Atmospheres
kimwipes.evidence_measured: spread rate vs O2, pressure, flow; opposed vs concurrent
kimwipes.note: Opposed spread reported faster than concurrent in most conditions

paraffin.label: Paraffin wax candle
paraffin.note: Fuel-model study, not a cabin material

japan_wax.label: Japan wax candle
japan_wax.note: Fuel-model study, not a cabin material

teflon.label: Teflon (PTFE)
teflon.note: Small particles are harder for light-scattering detectors

pyrell.label: Pyrell foam
pyrell.evidence_measured: smoke particles; morphology change at zero flow
pyrell.note: Smoke only; confirmed SAME-R flight material

cotton_wick.label: Cotton lamp wick
cotton_wick.note: Not the same sample as SIBAL or cotton jersey

silicone_smoke.label: Silicone rubber (smoke sample)
silicone_smoke.evidence_measured: large smoke particles; grow at lower flow
silicone_smoke.note: Separate record from Saffire silicone burns

dbp.label: Dibutyl phthalate on wick
dbp.note: Test substance, not a cabin material

urethane_generic.label: Urethane (generic)
urethane_generic.note: Pyrell smoke data does not cover generic urethanes
